content.text: iVH’s engineering has not been developed with a specific product or industry as its goal.
We have evolved **the methods of understanding, designing, verifying, and operating systems.**
And this engineering is still in the process of evolution.
Industries and technologies change rapidly.
Today's products will eventually disappear,
but the **right engineering survives even amidst such changes.**
To date, iVH has accumulated:
Based on these foundations,
we have expanded into the Mobility, Manufacturing, Energy, and Building industries.
Moving forward,
iVH will continue to **evolve with a focus not on products, but on Engineering.**

blocks.title: From Simulation to Operation, From Insight to Action

content.text: For future systems, being well-designed is no longer enough.
They must be **able to diagnose, judge, and improve themselves during the operational phase.**
iVH is expanding the core of engineering:
Digital Twins are no longer just analytical tools
but are becoming **an integral part of operational systems,**
and Physical AI is evolving beyond "assisting" judgment to **a technology that shares responsibility for operations.**

blocks.title: Scaling Engineering Across Complexity and Criticality

content.text: iVH’s future focus is on systems that are **more complex, more critical, and require higher levels of safety.**
These include:

items: Complex systems integrating energy, power, storage, and demand
Safety-critical environments where humans and machines coexist
Industrial sites where long-term repetitive operation is essential

content.text: In such systems, operations can no longer be sustained by experience and intuition alone.
Engineering becomes **the core infrastructure that supports the entire system.**
iVH believes that the evolution of **engineering cannot be separated from standards.**
Modelica, FMI, and ASAM are not fixed rules,
but **common languages** that must evolve alongside industry.
Moving forward, iVH will:

items: Actively participate in international standardization activities
Reflect domestic industrial requirements in standards

content.text: AI technology will continue to evolve rapidly.
However, iVH’s focus is not on "smarter AI,"
but on **AI that is trustworthy in the field.**
We continue to advance Physical AI Engineering that can operate in:

items: Environments with strong physical constraints and safety requirements
Industrial systems where failure is not an option

content.text: This is because AI must no longer remain a laboratory technology but **become a core technology that operates industries.**

blocks.title: An Open Future, Built on Engineering

content.text: iVH’s future engineering direction is not limited to a predefined list of industries.

items: New forms of automation and human-machine collaboration
Industrial sectors that have not yet been named

content.text: All of these will naturally expand upon the engineering foundations we have accumulated to date.

Industries change,
but our engineering that handles systems continues.
